title: Proof of qbeta delta tau canonical conditional q2 minus 1 factor
html:
By the per-block character closed forms, each per-block character satisfies \chi_\lambda(q) = (q^2 - 1) P_\lambda(q) for q > 0. Substituting these into the weighted sum and factoring out (q^2 - 1) yields the claim. \square

Limitations

  • Concrete canonical weights. The hypothesis is satisfied by the z = q^3/(q^2+1) Wenzl–Markov weights y_{(3)} = (q^4+1)/(q^2+1)^2, y_{(2,1)} = q^2/(q^2+1)^2, y_{(1^3)} = 0. These are rational in q and satisfy the normalisation. The hypothesis of the theorem is therefore met by the canonical weights.
  • Higher-order Taylor coefficients of \Delta\mathrm{tr}_M^{\text{can}}. Vanishing at q = 1 (order-0) is an immediate consequence. Higher orders depend on the specific behaviour of y_\lambda(q) at q = 1, which the dimension-normalisation axiom does not uniquely determine.
  • Bridge to the c_k precision ladder. The f-map itself remains open. What follows provides pre-archimedean structural input for the f-map, rather than completing the derivation.
